### Absalom Defeated
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/absalom-defeated
Passage: 2 Samuel 18:14-15
Points:
- Absalom's rebellion failed because God sovereignly frustrated human counsel to bring judgment upon him.
- Absalom's vanity led him into the wilderness battle where his head became trapped in an oak tree.
- Joab executed the rebel prince, carrying out the decisive judgment that David was reluctant to enact.
- Absalom suffered the cursed death and disgraced burial deserved by a rebellious traitor.
- God faithfully provides for His people during seasons of deep distress and exile.
